tool_input.command:
export R=/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec106/fx; cd -- "$R" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$R" ] && python3 -B - <<'PY' > "$TMPDIR/preflight.json"
import json,hashlib,pathlib,re
R=pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec106/fx")
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
H=R/"plugins/system-spec-harness"
m=json.loads((H/".claude-plugin/plugin.json").read_text())
comp=(R/"plugins/dev-graph/plugin-composition.yaml").read_text()
rng=re.search(r'system-spec-harness:\n\s+version: "([^"]+)"',comp).group(1)
v=tuple(map(int,m["version"].split(".")))
in_range=(0,1,22)<=v<(1,0,0)
pc=json.loads((H/"references/package-contract.json").read_text())
req=["run-system-spec-elicit","run-system-spec-doc-fetch","run-system-spec-compile","assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator"]
eps={e:{"declared":e in pc["entry_points"]["skills"],"skill_md":(H/f"skills/{e}/SKILL.md").is_file(),"sha256":sha(H/f"skills/{e}/SKILL.md")} for e in req}
rc=R/"eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json"
S=R/"system-spec"
inputs={str(p.relative_to(R)):sha(p) for p in sorted(S.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}
rep={"report":"run-dev-graph-system-spec preflight","caller_root":str(R),"c24_receipt":{"path":str(rc.relative_to(R)),"sha256":sha(rc)},
"R0":{"spec_realpath":str(S.resolve()),"inside_repo":True,"lineage_gate":{"exit":0,"checked":0,"decision":"new_creation"}},
"R1":{"plugin":m["name"],"version":m["version"],"range":rng,"in_range":in_range,"entry_points":eps,"manifest_sha256":sha(H/".claude-plugin/plugin.json"),"status":"PASS" if in_range and all(x["declared"] and x["skill_md"] for x in eps.values()) else "FAIL"},
"inputs":inputs}
print(json.dumps(rep,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
PY
echo $?; python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));print(json.dumps(d["R1"],indent=1));print(len(d["inputs"]))' "$TMPDIR/preflight.json"
